ancestors.title: Experiment Phase 2 - Manual interim and advance payment

storage.value:
After clicking on start Start billing button system should start invoice creation and should fill all the fields needed for invoice.

System should decide how many invoice should be created and on which level:

  1. Customer is selected

    1. System should create always one interim and advance payment.

    2. Should ignore what is selected in invoice 1- invoice 4 checkboxes

  2. Customer and contract is selected

    1. Only for service contract

    2. System should check how many invoices are selected in invoice 1-invocie 4 checkboxes and should create invoice with selected amount.

    3. e.g. if invoice 2, and invoice 4 is selected should generate 2 invoices

  3. Customer contract and billing group is selected

    1. only for product contract

    2. Firstly should check how many billing groups are selected and for each billing group to create interim

    3. Secondly, system should check how many invoices are selected in invoice 1-invocie 4 checkboxes and should create invoice with selected amount.

    4. e.g. if 10 billing group is added and invoice1, invoice2, invoice3, invoice4 is selected should create 40 interim

    5. "We have four billing groups. If we select the checkbox for Invoice 1 - we should generate 4 invoices

    6. "We have one billing group. If we select the checkbox for Invoice 4, we should generate one invoice

    7. "We have four billing groups. If we select the checkboxes for Invoice 3 and Invoice 4, we should generete 8 invoices

    8. "We have one billing group. If we select the checkbox for Invoice 1/4, we should generete 2 invoice

    9. "We have two billing groups: Billing Group 1 and Billing Group 2. In Billing Group 1, the 'separate invoice for each point of delivery' option is checked. There are a total of 3 points of delivery in Billing Group 1. In Billing Group 2, this option is not checked. If we select Invoice 3, we should generete 4 invoices

    10. "We have two billing groups: Billing Group 1 and Billing Group 2. In Billing Group 1, the 'separate invoice for each point of delivery' option is checked. There are a total of 3 points of delivery in Billing Group 1. In Billing Group 2, this option is not checked. If we select Invoice 1/4, We should generete 8 (6/2)

Amount Calculation steps:

  1. Invoice amount should take from amount excluding VAT value

  2. Value should convert to default currency

  3. Rounding should be done after converting, standard Round after the second digit

  4. Based on selected VAT rate calculate VAT amount. After calculation rounding should be done after converting, standard Round after the second digit

    1. if manual is checked amount is taken from manual inteirm object

    2. if manual is not checked amount is taken from selected contract’s respective product version (respective for current day)

  5. Calculate total amount

    1. invoice amount + Vat amount

Document type: Invoice

Invoice type: interim

For listed fields if manual is checked in manual interim object should implement additional logic to define value:

Number of income account

  • Values should be taken from respective product version for billing run start date

Cost center/Controlling order

  • Value should be taken from respective product version for billing run start date

Applicable interest rate

  • Value should be taken from respective contract version for billing run start date

Direct Debit

  • Value should be taken from respective object for billing run start date

    1. First priority to take value is billing group, second priority is to take from contract respective for billing run start date and third priority is to take from customer. if not added empty

All other fields should take directly from interim object

Number

  1. Prefix is generated automatically by Contract

  2. If in the billing run the Contract sub object is the Product, the Invoice should be take n the prefix “ (Product interim/advance payment invoice))” from the nomenclature

  3. If the billing run is the “Service contract” the invoice should be taken the prefix (Service interim/advance payment invoice)

  4. Prefix is created by contract if the contract/order is not added ( its optional ) prefix should be generated by Prefix type radio buttons .

Number of income account

The “manual” checkbox is not selected and added sub object is the “Contract”, the “Number of income account” should be taken from Product/Service.

The “Manual” checkbox is selected, in this cases the system user should add “Number of income account” manually

If contract is not added the the “Manual” checkbox is automatically selected.

Basis for issuing

Basis for issuing

Cost center/Controlling order

The “manual” checkbox is not selected and added sub object is the “Contract”, the “Cost center/Controlling order” should be taken from Product/Service.(This field is mandatory in the Product/Service)

The “Manual” checkbox is selected, in this cases the system user should add “Cost center/Controlling order” manually

If contract is not added the the “Manual” checkbox is automatically selected and its mandatory to fill this textfield

VAT rate

The “manual” checkbox is not selected and the Contract/Order sub object is added. If added sub object is the “Contract/Service order”, the “VAT rate” should be taken from Product/Service.(This field is mandatory in the Product/Service)
If the added sub object is the “Good Order”, the “VAT rate” should be taken from Goods order. (VAT rate is mandatory in the goods order)

The “Manual” checkbox is selected, in this cases the system user should add “VAT rate” manually

If contract is not added the the “Manual” checkbox is automatically selected and its mandatory to fill this field

Applicable interest rate

The “manual” checkbox is not selected and the “Contract” sub-object is added, the “Applicable interest rate” should be taken from Contract.

Bank

The "manual" checkbox is not selected. If the system user adds only a customer sub-object, the field should be filled from the customer's information. If this field is empty in the customer object, the bank field in the invoice will also remain empty.

The "manual" checkbox is not selected. If the system user adds multiple billing groups, each generated invoice should use the bank details from the respective billing group. If the billing group lacks bank details, the system should take them from the contract. If the contract does not have the "Bank," the system should check the customer. If none of these sources provide the bank details, the field on the invoice will remain empty.( The genereted invoice will be without Bank )

For service contracts, service orders, or goods orders, the bank details should be taken from the contract or order. If the contract/order does not have the "Bank," the system should check the customer. If none of these sources provide the bank details, the field on the invoice will remain empty.

If the system user checks the "manual" checkbox, all created invoices should use the same bank account specified in this field, despite what we have in the billing group or contract/order/customer

BIC

Bank Account

Sub - Object

 

Customer

Customer ( UIC/PN/PN of foreigner + version of the customer )

Contract/Order

Contract , its optional so it can be empty in the invoice

Billing Group

Billing group, available after adding contract in the sub object and mandatory to add at least one

Recipient of an invoice

Billing group alternative/Customer

Communication data for billing

Invoice communication data

Product/Service

From the Contract/Order which is added in the sub object

Template

Invoice Template
